resources.string: Set up 2FA to access your vault
Your company requires you to use 2-factor authentication (2FA) for additional security.\n\nYou can set up 2FA by use an authenticator app, log in from your computer browser.
Before logging in, make sure this is the Dashlane account you want to log in to:
Use a logged in device to access Dashlane
Don’t have a logged in device?
Log in to Dashlane with a security challenge
Always use the Dashlane browser extension or mobile app to add a new device.
Open Dashlane on one of your logged in devices
Go to Dashlane settings and select Add new device
Validate the new device request, then a security challenge will be displayed here
Use your recovery key to log in to Dashlane

If you don’t have a logged in device available, you can use your recovery key to log in to Dashlane.\n\nBefore you start the recovery process, make sure you have your single-use recovery key. Depending on your security settings, additional verification may be required to complete the recovery process.
If you don’t have a recovery method available
You need a logged in device or your recovery key to access your account on this device. If none of these methods are available, you can start the process of resetting your account.
Use this word list to complete the challenge on your logged in device.
Please try logging in again or visit our help center.
New device request has timed out
The request to set up a new device has timed out. Go to login and try again.
